statement:
The record specifies administrator of the whole company.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="assign_access_package">
<parameter name="id">AR-3391</parameter>
<parameter name="value">read-only</parameter>

judge_text:
WRONG
It flags that "the record specifies administrator of the whole company" and then supplies the correct value by assigning "read-only" instead.
